selected_story_titles: Sentinel-3C returns its first thermal-infrared Earth images
Device-independent quantum position verification beats equal-latency classical localization
A two-dimensional Bose gas simulates a massive relativistic quantum field
Cluster-based sampling outperforms active learning across a large materials benchmark
A human hypothalamus atlas maps selective vulnerability in ageing and Alzheimer’s disease
Amazon leaf shedding is widespread and often decoupled from canopy greenness
Late Homo erectus occupied southern Chinese rainforest environments
Kuiper-belt dust preserves evidence for an isotopically heavy primordial water reservoir
A plasma immunoassay measures a marker of advanced insoluble tau pathology

checks.result: Sentinel-3C commissioning, device-independent quantum position verification, analogue relativistic-field simulation and the newly reported Kuiper-belt dust study were selected. Astrophysical transient reports already owned by alerts were excluded.
No same-window result passed both significance and primary-source-verification thresholds. An Escher exhibition feature and incremental or unverified preprints were not selected.
The 100-algorithm, 60-task materials training-set benchmark was selected; its fixed-library scope and full-text access limitation are explicit.
Amazon phenology and late Homo erectus ecological adaptation were selected. Mechanistic animal and cell studies without comparable general significance were screened out.
Cluster-based training-set selection was selected as a data-efficient materials-design method. No additional same-window chemistry result displaced the stronger candidates.
Late Homo erectus, Kuiper-belt dust and Sentinel-3C were selected with publication, observation and announcement dates separated.
HypoAD and the eMTBR-tau immunoassay were selected. Cross-sectional atlas and biomarker associations were not described as causal or clinically validated.

access_gaps: The cluster-selection paper's full methods and supplementary comparisons were subscription-only; reporting is limited to the abstract, figure descriptions and data/code statement.
Detailed HypoAD supplementary analyses were inaccessible; reporting is limited to the full abstract, data statement and indexed metadata.
Some journal and institutional archive pages were dynamically loaded and could not be exhaustively enumerated.
No claim of exhaustive journal coverage or verified absence in unselected fields is made.
